Laser printers are consistently more reliable than inkjet printers, based on Consumer Reports' surveys.

Consumer Reports' surveys, based on 69,886 individual printers purchased between 2016 and 2024, indicate significant differences in reliability among printer brands and types, particularly for inkjet printers.

Many inkjet printers are designed for the lowest possible selling price, often leading to lower long-term reliability due to complex internal machinery (motors, pulleys, gears) that can fail. [Consumer Reports]
Initial savings on inexpensive inkjet printers are often offset several times over by high ink costs during the first few years of ownership. [Consumer Reports]
Consumer Reports rarely recommends traditional inkjet printers due to their hidden costs and reliability problems, which lead to low owner satisfaction ratings.
Solid alternatives to traditional inkjets include laser printers and tank-style inkjets. [Consumer Reports]
Inkjet printers are suitable if you don't print a lot and need a combination of text, graphics, and photos (especially in color), but be aware of their drawbacks. [Consumer Reports]

report.summary: For home use in 2026, laser printers remain the most reliable and cheapest to run for documents, while ink-tank models win for color and photos. Hands-on testing by PCMag and Wirecutter consistently puts Brother laser all-in-ones at the top for reliability and speed, with Epson EcoTank and Canon MegaTank as the best low-ink-cost alternatives.

products.name: Brother MFC-L3780CDW All-in-One Color Laser
pros: PCMag Editors' Choice with 4.5 Outstanding rating for mainstream color laser - top pick in two PCMag roundups
Fastest print speeds in its class per RTINGS comparison - quicker than Canon Color imageCLASS MF665Cdw
Laser output resists fading and smudging better than inkjet and delivers crisp text and line graphics
cons: High upfront cost at $569.98 vs sub-$200 ink-tanks
Larger footprint than single-function lasers - not ideal for tiny desks
Toner replacement cost higher per cartridge than bottled ink, though lower per page than cartridge inkjet
products.verdict: Hands-on testing by PCMag confirms this is the best all-around home/small-office printer if you want color laser reliability. It's expensive upfront but avoids ink-drying and clogging issues that plague cheap inkjets. Best for families who print documents regularly and want scan/copy too.

products.name: Brother DCP-L2640DW Monochrome Laser All-in-One
pros: Wirecutter Best Home Printer pick for 2026 - described as reliable, cheap to buy and run, simple to operate
Laser reliability advantage - Consumer Reports surveys of 69,886 printers show Brother laser among most reliable
Toner doesn't dry out during occasional use, unlike cartridge inkjets
cons: Monochrome only - no color photo printing
No fax function unlike MFC series
Slower color graphics handling by design
products.verdict: Wirecutter hands-on testing names this the best for most homes because it just works. If you don't need color, this is cheaper to run than any inkjet and won't punish you for not printing for weeks. Ideal for documents, schoolwork, and forms.
products.best_for: Best for most homes - black and white

products.name: Epson EcoTank ET-3950 All-in-One Supertank
pros: PCMag top pick for inkjet all-in-one - does away with cartridges and offers DIY refills
Bottled ink costs around 80% less than cartridges, giving lowest long-term cost for color
Tank system avoids frequent cartridge swaps for high-volume color
cons: Ink can still clog if left unused for months - requires occasional printing
Maintenance box can fill and lock printer software until replaced, per user reports
Slower than laser for text-heavy jobs
products.verdict: Hands-on expert testing by PCMag recommends this as the inkjet alternative to laser. If you need affordable color and photos at home, EcoTank's refillable tanks solve the hidden-cost problem Consumer Reports warns about with traditional inkjets.
products.best_for: Best ink-tank for color on a budget

products.name: Canon Pixma G3270 Wireless MegaTank All-In-One
pros: PCMag current best budget-printer pick with 4.0 Excellent rating
MegaTank bottled ink system for low cost per page
Priced at $159 at Amazon - capable multifunction under $150-$200 threshold
cons: Inkjet reliability lower than laser per Consumer Reports surveys
Slower than Brother laser models for document batches
Photo quality good but not at level of dedicated photo printers like XP-8800
products.verdict: PCMag hands-on testing confirms this is the best cheap all-in-one if you want color under $200. It trades some speed and laser crispness for very cheap ink and decent photo output. Good for light home use with occasional photos.

products.name: HP LaserJet M209d
pros: PCMag Editors' Choice for home laser with 4.0 Excellent rating
Lowest upfront cost for laser at $109 at Amazon (originally $159)
Compact monochrome laser ideal for small spaces
cons: Single function - print only, no scan or copy
No wireless in d model - requires USB/wired connection vs dw variants
HP toner ecosystem more expensive than Brother in some regions
products.verdict: PCMag hands-on testing highlights this as the cheapest way into reliable laser printing for home. If you just need to print documents and already have a phone scanner, it's hard to beat at $109. Avoid if you need all-in-one features.
products.best_for: Best cheap laser for documents only

products.name: Epson Expression Photo XP-8800
pros: PCMag Editors' Choice with 4.5 Outstanding rating for photo printers
Top pick for home photo printing among decades of PCMag expert reviews
Superior color accuracy and detail for photos vs office lasers
cons: Cartridge-based ink - higher cost per page than EcoTank models
Not ideal for high-volume text - slower and less crisp than laser for documents
Photo printers require more maintenance to avoid nozzle clogs
products.verdict: Hands-on expert testing by PCMag rates this the best photo printer for home use. Buy this only if photos are your priority; for mixed home use, pair a cheap laser like M209d with this or choose an EcoTank instead.
products.best_for: Best for photo printing at home
